Payout & mining setup

Your BCH2 payout address receives every block you solo-mine — the block's coinbase pays it directly on-chain (no separate payout transaction). Changes apply within a few seconds; no restart needed. A valid-but-wrong address is unrecoverable, so double-check it.

Because each block pays you directly, there is no minimum payout and no payout schedule — nothing accumulates, and nothing is waiting to be sent. A block's reward is spendable after the usual 100-block coinbase maturity.

The worker username is only a label for the stats on this dashboard. All BCH2 block rewards go to the single payout address you set above — not to the worker username. Every share also merge-mines 1175 (ESF) for free when a 1175 address is set.

Rented hashpower uses a port that depends on how the marketplace connects. Braiins connects each miner individually, so it uses the same port as your own hardware — 3333 — and every connection finds its own difficulty. NiceHash and MiningRigRentals put the whole order behind one connection, so they use port 3335, whose difficulty floor is much higher to suit an aggregated order. That is a floor, not a starting point: a connection on 3335 is never assigned less, so point a single small rig at 3333 instead.

Two things to know either way: the address above is a local one, so a marketplace can only reach it through a port forward or a tunnel; and you can set the starting difficulty by putting d=2000000 in the password field to skip the automatic ramp. It is a starting point, not a lock: vardiff still adjusts from there once your real share rate is known, and a connection that has not landed a share in 3 minutes drops back to the port’s floor.

BCH2 mining is never affected by 1175: if the 1175 node is unreachable or still syncing, this app keeps mining BCH2 normally and simply stops adding the 1175 commitment until it recovers.

1175 (ESF) is merge-mined at no extra hashrate cost. Its reward is paid on-chain directly to the ESF address above. Set that address in Payout & mining setup to turn merge-mining on.
